description:
PROFIL

• Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Informationstechnologie oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit IAM-Lösungen im Enterprise-Umfeld, idealerweise One Identity Manager

• Sehr gutes Verständnis von IAM-Konzepten wie RBAC, ABAC, SSO, MFA, Identity Lifecycle Management und Access Governance

• Erfahrung mit Active Directory, LDAP, Entra ID / Azure AD sowie hybriden IT- und Cloud-Umgebungen

• Gute Kenntnisse in PowerShell, SQL sowie idealerweise OneIM-Scripting und Customizing

• Strukturierte, analytische und serviceorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie starke Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit in internationalen Umgebungen

AUFGABEN

• Design, Implementierung und Betrieb der Enterprise-IAM-Plattform auf Basis von One Identity Manager in hybriden IT-Umgebungen (On-Prem & Cloud)

• Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung von Identity-Lifecycle-Prozessen wie Joiner/Mover/Leaver, Provisioning, De-Provisioning, Rollenmanagement und Access Reviews

• Entwicklung und Automatisierung von IAM-Prozessen mittels PowerShell, SQL sowie One Identity Manager Scripting & Customizing

• Integration von Zielsystemen wie Active Directory, Entra ID, HR-Systemen (z. B. SAP SuccessFactors), Cloud-Plattformen und Business-Applikationen

• Sicherstellung von Stabilität, Performance, Security und Compliance der IAM-Plattform inklusive Monitoring, Patch- und Release-Management

• Unterstützung von Audits sowie Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen, Betriebsprozesse und Architekturunterlagen

descriptionByLocale.it: Profilo - Studio di informatica, tecnologia dell'informazione o qualifica comparabile completato - Esperienza pratica pluriennale con soluzioni IAM in ambiente Enterprise, idealmente One Identity Manager - Ottima comprensione di concetti IAM come RBAC, ABAC, SSO, MFA, Identity Lifecycle Management e Access Governance - Esperienza con Active Directory, LDAP, Entra ID / Azure AD nonché ambienti IT ibridi e cloud - Buone conoscenze di PowerShell, SQL e idealmente scripting e personalizzazione di OneIM - Lavoro strutturato, analitico e orientato al servizio nonché forti capacità di comunicazione e di lavoro in team in ambienti internazionali Descrizione - Progettazione, implementazione e gestione della piattaforma Enterprise IAM basata su One Identity Manager in ambienti IT ibridi (On-Prem & Cloud) - Implementazione e sviluppo di processi di Identity Lifecycle come Joiner/Mover/Leaver, provisioning, de-provisioning, gestione dei ruoli e revisioni degli accessi - Sviluppo e automazione di processi IAM tramite PowerShell, SQL e scripting & personalizzazione di One Identity Manager - Integrazione di sistemi target come Active Directory, Entra ID, sistemi HR (ad es. SAP SuccessFactors), piattaforme cloud e applicazioni aziendali - Garanzia di stabilità, prestazioni, sicurezza e conformità della piattaforma IAM, compreso monitoraggio, gestione patch e release - Supporto agli audit e creazione e manutenzione di documentazione tecnica, processi operativi e documenti di architettura Contatto
descriptionByLocale.en: Profile - Completed degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or comparable qualification - Several years of practical experience with IAM solutions in an enterprise environment, ideally One Identity Manager - Very good understanding of IAM concepts such as RBAC, ABAC, SSO, MFA, Identity Lifecycle Management and Access Governance - Experience with Active Directory, LDAP, Entra ID / Azure AD as well as hybrid IT and cloud environments - Good knowledge of PowerShell, SQL and ideally OneIM scripting and customizing - Structured, analytical and service-oriented way of working as well as strong communication and teamwork skills in international environments Description - Design, implementation and operation of the Enterprise IAM platform based on One Identity Manager in hybrid IT environments (On-Prem & Cloud) - Implementation and further development of Identity Lifecycle processes such as Joiner/Mover/Leaver, provisioning, de-provisioning, role management and access reviews - Development and automation of IAM processes using PowerShell, SQL and One Identity Manager scripting & customizing - Integration of target systems such as Active Directory, Entra ID, HR systems (e.g. SAP SuccessFactors), cloud platforms and business applications - Ensuring stability, performance, security and compliance of the IAM platform including monitoring, patch and release management - Support for audits as well as creation and maintenance of technical documentation, operational processes and architecture documents Contact

descriptionByLocale.fr: Profil - Diplôme en informatique, technologie de l'information ou qualification comparable achevé - Plusieurs années d'expérience pratique avec des solutions IAM en environnement d'entreprise, idéalement One Identity Manager - Très bonne compréhension des concepts IAM tels que RBAC, ABAC, SSO, MFA, gestion du cycle de vie des identités et gouvernance des accès - Expérience avec Active Directory, LDAP, Entra ID / Azure AD ainsi que des environnements IT hybrides et cloud - Bonnes connaissances de PowerShell, SQL et idéalement de scripting et de personnalisation de OneIM - Travail structuré, analytique et orienté service ainsi que fortes capacités de communication et de travail en équipe dans des environnements internationaux Description - Conception, mise en œuvre et exploitation de la plateforme IAM d'entreprise basée sur One Identity Manager dans des environnements IT hybrides (On-Prem & Cloud) - Mise en œuvre et développement de processus de gestion du cycle de vie des identités tels que Joiner/Mover/Leaver, provisionnement, dé-provisionnement, gestion des rôles et révisions des accès - Développement et automatisation de processus IAM à l'aide de PowerShell, SQL et de scripting & personnalisation de One Identity Manager - Intégration de systèmes cibles tels que Active Directory, Entra ID, systèmes RH (par exemple SAP SuccessFactors), plateformes cloud et applications métier - Garantie de la stabilité, des performances, de la sécurité et de la conformité de la plateforme IAM, y compris la surveillance, la gestion des correctifs et des versions - Support pour les audits ainsi que la création et la maintenance de la documentation technique, des processus opérationnels et des documents d'architecture Contact
